title: Angel's Cave Markers
description: Do you get lost in caves? Well do i have the mod for you!
body:
This mod adds three simple peices of chalk: 
- black chalk: crafted with either coal, charcoal or ink sacks.
  - makes black marks
- white chalk: crafted with bonemeal or white die
  - makes white marks
- glowing chalk: crafted with white chalk and glowstone dust
  - places marks that emit low light and glow.
You can use these while caving to easily mark your way back. 

Generally i made this mod for myself as i get lost really easily in the new cave systems, but i figured it may help others also! So here we are, i hope it may help you also.
